about: Planted truth for acceptance/cases/old-footage/eval.py, by make.py. The footage is real (see files/ATTRIBUTION.md); places, accounts, captions and dates are fictional.

story.title: The footage that was two years old
story.puzzle: On the morning of 2 June 2026 a clip of the river Ostra over its banks in Lindmark spreads under the caption 'JUST IN'. A newsroom's tip line holds 36 clips from the same days, many of them brown water under grey skies, and has to say which ones are new.
story.twist: The viral clip is a cropped, mirrored, trimmed, logo-stamped re-encode of a video Ostra Valley Weather posted on 3 June 2024. Its picture no longer matches but its sound does, and the fingerprints tie it and seven other reposts to the two-year-old original.

lindmark.note: Invented town on the invented river Ostra. The footage was filmed elsewhere; see files/ATTRIBUTION.md.

a red banner across the top and a logo block in the lower right
cropped to the central 70% and scaled back up
cut to an upright 9:16 frame from the centre, as a phone short
cropped to the central 80%, mirrored, trimmed to seconds 3 to 17, logo-stamped and re-encoded at 480 pixels wide
the viral copy downloaded, muted and uploaded again
cut to an upright 9:16 frame, mirrored, with its sound removed

truth.note: transformations are relative to the original. Every pair inside {original, copies} is the same recording; no other pair in this set is. known_misses are measured by eval.py, not hidden.

conclusion.text: The clip shared as new on 2 June 2026 is a copy of the video Ostra Valley Weather posted on 3 June 2024.

alternatives.text: Two recordings of the same flood from the same spot
alternatives.why: The sound of the two clips lines up point for point, and six other reposts match the 2024 video too.

not_established: Who made the first altered copy.
One muted, cropped and mirrored copy matched nothing.

acts.title: The clip that spread
acts.story: A clip of the river Ostra over its banks in Lindmark spreads under 'JUST IN' and reaches the newsroom's tip line with its post. The app listens for speech, looks at eight frames and proposes a title, a description and labels for what the clip shows. The caption is what the post reports, unconfirmed.

acts.title: Reposts and other floods
acts.story: Over the day the tip line fills with reposts, other people's flood videos and clips that only look like weather. The app reads each one as it arrives and fingerprints its picture and sound. Several reposts already match each other by their sound: one recording is spreading, but nothing here says where it began.

acts.title: Searching the pile by what it shows
acts.story: More clips arrive in a batch from the inbox. Instead of scrolling 35 videos, the desk searches for what the viral clip shows, submerged trees, and finds the reposts and one other flood by the app's own description of them. A search for the bridge the captions name finds two other people's bridges and one post; the app saw no bridge in the viral clip. A description says what the frames show, never where or when they were filmed.

acts.title: The archive from two years ago
acts.story: A producer remembers a flood clip from June 2024 and the desk adds Ostra Valley Weather's video from the archive. Its fingerprints tie it to the viral clip and to six other reposts by their sound, and two of those by picture too. The search for submerged trees now finds the 2024 video as well.

acts.title: Side by side
acts.story: The analyst opens the viral clip beside the 2024 video, plays them together and confirms each match between the copies and the original as the same recording, with her reason and her passkey. The app proposed nothing between clips that are not the same footage, so there is nothing to decline. The muted, cropped, mirrored short matched nothing and stays unexplained.

steps.why: Side by side the same footage: the same river, trees and buildings and the same sound, cut, mirrored or stamped differently.

acts.title: The conclusion
acts.story: The analyst writes that the clip shared as new is the 2024 video, on the two posts' words beside the confirmed matches, names the alternative she set aside and what is not established, and signs it; a reviewer agrees.
